themes.name: hyperclass
themes.title: HYPERCLASS — Gilded Void
themes.description: First class aboard a starliner crossing the void: champagne brass on deep-space ink, ivory starlight, one vein of ice. Ships an orrery clock, a hyperspace warp and a self-printing boarding pass for the terminal.
themes.author: blyatiful1

themes.name: magma
themes.title: MAGMA — Obsidian Flow
themes.description: Obsidian glass over a living magma chamber: ember orange, lava gold, one cool teal vein. Molten-glass blur and a terminal full of fluid sims — lava lamp, DOOM fire, cracking obsidian.
themes.author: blyatiful1

themes.name: netrunner
themes.title: NETRUNNER — Jack In
themes.description: A netrunner's deck in Night City: HUD cyan on desaturated navy void, one cyber-yellow signature per surface, Edgerunners hot-pink in the terminal's veins. Ships a live Night City wallpaper (Hanabi), the lavat ICE lamp, and a Breach Protocol greeting. Strictly border-free.
themes.author: blyatiful1
